exposure: babies born via normal vaginal delivery
cohort: 74 neonates admitted to the neonatal wards of a tertiary care hospital during the year of 2017-2018 who were treated for hyperbilirubinemia
finding: The incidence of hyperbilirubinemia was higher in female babies than male babies, preterm babies than term babies, and babies born via LSCS than normal vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The incidence of hyperbilirubinemia was higher in babies born via LSCS than normal vaginal delivery.
